## Key updates

**Inpainting (new tab)** — brush a mask, regenerate only that region. ~34 s in crop mode (default).

**Dual LoRA slots + VAE switch** — main slot (accepts speed LoRAs) and an extra slot (regular LoRAs, stacked in series). Measured overhead: +5–9 s, per-step speed unchanged. VAE selectable on all five tabs.

**7-element prompt builder** — fill camera / subject / pose / setting+light / skin / explicit detail / finish. Composed in fixed order, with live character count (300–1500 recommended) and missing-field hints.

**L0–L3 boldness tiers** — appends camera + pose wording to the **end** of the prompt. Never touches sampling parameters.

## Other changes

- Sampler `er_sde` added; max steps 40 → 60
- Size presets split: width/height `[768, 1024, 1152, 1280, 1344]`, long side `[768, 1024, 1280]` (1728 dropped — hit 96% VRAM on the edit tab)
- CLI: new `loras` / `vaes` / `styles` / `status` / `enhance` subcommands; new flags `--lora2`, `--vae`, `--boldness`, `--sampler`, `--scheduler`
- i18n: zh/en parity, 286 keys each

## Benchmarks (RTX 2000 Ada Laptop, 8 GB)

| Workload | Time |
|---|---|
| t2i 1024² | 63 s → **30 s** with speed LoRA |
| Image edit | 186 s |
| Background removal | 87 s |
| Pose transfer | 150 s |
| **Inpainting (crop)** | **34 s** |

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Per-step cost with LoRA | 2.13 → 2.94 s/it (**+38%**) |
| Peak VRAM (768×1152) | 7167 / 8188 MiB |

## Upgrade

Overwrite the repo files into your ComfyUI root — no model re-download needed.

Two new files: `_api_inpaint.json`, `_api_inpaint_crop.json`.

All new LoRAs are optional; no weights are bundled with this repo.
